name: Mattermost GitLab Compatibility
description: Returns user data in GitLab format for Mattermost SSO
expression:
return {
    "id": request.user.pk,
    "username": request.user.username,
    "login": request.user.username,
    "email": request.user.email,
    "name": request.user.name,
    "avatar_url": "",
}

name: Mattermost OpenID + GitLab Compat
description: OpenID scope with GitLab-compatible fields for Mattermost Free Edition SSO
expression:
return {
    "sub": str(request.user.pk),
    "id": request.user.pk,
    "username": request.user.username,
    "login": request.user.username,
    "email": request.user.email,
    "name": request.user.name,
    "avatar_url": "",
}
